messages:
deploybot: Deploy blocked — CI gate failed for production canary deploy (release v2.4.1-rc3)
Environment: prod-canary
Commit: abcdef1234 (tag: v2.4.1-rc3)
Failed checks: integration-suite (job #742), e2e-payment (step timeout)
Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/742
Status: hold by policy until CI gate clears

emma: on it, grabbing logs now

raj: which tests in integration-suite failed? flaky or legit?

ci-bot: integration-suite › payments/checkout_flow_spec failed (3/3 attempts)
Failing examples:
```
Payments::CheckoutFlow handles 3DS callback when payment provider returns 402
Payments::CheckoutFlow retries on transient connection error (timeout)
```
Also seeing 15s timeouts in chrome headless on step 4

sasha: hmm we just merged db-migration that touches payment tables in yesterday's canary. Could be related.

liam: if it's migration-related we should avoid forcing a rollback until we confirm read-only compat. Pinning to previous commit to unblock prod might be safer.

olivia: agree. Proposal: pin release to commit 9f8e7d6 (last green), open a deploy-pin patch and re-run integration-suite. If tests pass, we can cut a hotfix for the migration and rerun canary later.

emma: I can open the pin PR and trigger a rerun. tagging @raj for approval on the hotfix workflow.

raj: approve for pin and rerun. If rerun passes, promote pinned artifact. If rerun fails again, we rollback to plan B (manual rollback + incident doc).

deploybot: Action queued: create patch-release pin PR -> branch: release-pin/1981234567 -> target commit: 9f8e7d6. Rerun requested for integration-suite (job #743).

ci-bot: job #743 started (rerun of integration-suite).

olivia: documenting decision in release notes draft and CC-ing support to hold change window. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: job #743 finished — integration-suite: 8/8 tests passed, e2e-payment: passed (no timeouts).

emma: rerun green. Proceeding to promote pinned artifact and unblock canary. I'll follow up with the hotfix PR for the migration and link the failing traces.

liam: thanks everyone. After hotfix PR is up let's schedule an additional canary with extended e2e timeout for payment steps.

deploybot: Deployment unblocked for prod-canary (artifact pinned to 9f8e7d6). Release state: held -> canary resumed.
